abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3.

abilities.name: Slip Into Shadow
abilities.description: Even if in full view of a creature, your successful stealth task allows you to slip away from that creature and hide from view in a nearby shadow, behind a tree or furnishing, or in the next room as your action.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Attempt to slip away from one additional target looking directly at you (attempt a separate stealth task against each).
